purpose: Updated priority queue after wave-4 discovery and mechanism verification. Rank by incremental validation value, independence, rights clarity and likelihood of becoming canonical evidence.

priorityQueue.why: Still the single largest gap between public research breadth and a defensible MouldMaster real-production validation claim.
No external educational dataset can establish MouldMaster item difficulty, discrimination, confidence calibration or learning gain.
The app now has prepared blinded case packets but still has no independent MouldMaster-specific engineering labels.
priorityQueue.currentState: 20 blinded packets; 0 completed independent blinded labels

priorityQueue.gap: Rights-clear multi-machine / multi-mould industrial pressure and anomaly data
priorityQueue.why: Would improve transfer, drift, anomaly and bad-shot validation across genuinely different work systems.

priorityQueue.gap: Extract and profile the LEGO six-machine-family energy appendix
priorityQueue.why: 275 industrial steady-state measurements across six machine families are unusually valuable independent calibration data; publisher explicitly states research data are in Appendix 1 and the final article is CC BY.
priorityQueue.nextAction: Retrieve exact final PDF/Appendix through a supported route, fingerprint, extract literal research rows and separate measurements from regression outputs.

priorityQueue.gap: Recover and profile the RWTH PCR archive
priorityQueue.why: Authoritative record now clearly exposes the ZIP endpoint and rich cavity-pressure/part-mass semantics, but the current automated environment still fails to deliver the binary payload.
priorityQueue.nextAction: Use publisher-supported/manual authoritative transfer, then fingerprint and profile without committing raw files.

priorityQueue.gap: Machine/mould maintenance lifecycle data with actual component failures
priorityQueue.why: Current operations and energy datasets are strong on state/downtime but weak on component degradation -> maintenance action -> recovery.
Measured hot-runner studies exist, but command/display versus actual manifold/nozzle/valve state remains thin.

priorityQueue.gap: Tool wear / cooling-circuit / ejection-force longitudinal data
priorityQueue.why: Public studies support these mechanisms, but longitudinal production records linking tool condition to shot-level quality remain scarce.

Eight manufacturer-controlled exact-grade sources are now staged, including Victrex PEEK 450G, but each still needs exact PDS revision/retrieval date/SHA-256 and field-level test-context mapping before material-grade-v2 promotion.

priorityQueue.gap: Raw gate-freeze and micro-injection pressure cycles
priorityQueue.why: Article-level evidence is now strong; raw repeated cycles would unlock direct trace-based assessment and benchmark validation.

priorityQueue.gap: Specialist gas/projectile-assisted raw data and rights-clear professional tooling CAD
priorityQueue.why: Fluid-assisted mechanism evidence is now substantially stronger at article level, so raw specialist datasets and explicit CAD licensing are the remaining value rather than more papers.

mechanismStatusAfterWave4.note: Strong re-review does not mean automatic promotion; canonical criteria and independent-source overlap checks still apply.

deprioritized: additional generic single-material time series without new context
generic polymer property compilations when exact manufacturer grade documents exist
